topic_title: Reduce Risk — Zero Tolerance Practices & Impairment
prompt: If you spot an erratic, suspected impaired driver ahead on a Texas roadway, what should you do?

options.text: Maintain safe distance, do not pass, pull over safely, and call 911 to report
Accelerate quickly to overtake the vehicle and cut closely in front of it
Follow closely with high beams active and honk your horn to keep them awake
Pull alongside the vehicle and shout through the window to pull over
